item.title: 2027 Audi RS5 Looks Menacing and Packs a 630-HP Plug-In Powertrain
item.description: While Audi's four-door hatchback gets more complex, the newest generation significantly ups the performance ante too.

item.title: View Exterior and Interior Photos of the 2027 Audi RS5
item.description: Check out the styling inside and out of the new 2027 Audi RS5, which adopts a potent plug-in hybrid powertrain.

item.title: View Exterior Photos of the 2027 Audi RS5
item.description: See the totally redesigned 2027 Audi RS5 hatchback from every exterior angle.

item.title: 20,000 Miles In, and Problems Just Waft Past This 2024 Lucid Air
item.description: Just past the halfway mark, we still love driving the rear-drive Air Pure, quirks and all.

item.title: View Exterior Photos of the 2024 Lucid Air Pure RWD
item.description: 2024 Lucid Air Pure RWD exterior photos.

item.title: Future Electric Vehicles: The EVs You'll Soon Be Able to Buy
item.description: These EVs aren't for sale yet but are in various stages from concept to production—and perhaps a few may never see the light of day.

item.title: Mercedes-Benz Issues Recall for EQB Electric SUV over Fire Risk
item.description: The automaker will replace the EQB's high-voltage battery, which could short-circuit, posing a fire risk.

item.title: Tesla Drops "Autopilot" Name After Legal Pressure from California
item.description: After the California DMV threatened to strip Tesla of its dealer license, the automaker changed the way it markets its driver assistance features.

item.title: Nissan Recalls 318K Rogue SUVs with Self-Destructing Throttle Bodies
item.description: The broken throttle body can keep the Rogue from moving forward or backward, increasing the chance of a crash.

item.title: BMW M CEO Says the Era of Manual Transmissions Is Nearly Over
item.description: Frank van Meel said that while he'd love to keep the manual transmission for as long as possible, reality is a bit harsher than that.
